This beacon still broadcasts over the Korriban Debris Field, the wreckage of fleets that fought and died above the Sith homeworld. Ancient Aurodium plating lies among the hulks, and salvagers risk everything to strip it.

The message is as follows:
"Warning! Derelict defense turrets and mines remain active in this field, and the Red Hand claims its salvage as their own. Only Small and Medium ships can pass between the wrecks."
